name: Sport Qory (Fund for Support of Sport)
note: Corporate fund ('Корпоративный фонд «Фонд поддержки спорта»'); Kazakhstan's designated single operator for distributing off-budget sports money, managing Barys HC and other Astana clubs; main funding from the quasi-state sector with Samruk-Kazyna as general partner (claim sportqory-state-operator). Its own history names JSC Kazsportinvest as the 2010 founder; current legal founders not published.
